package.description: A free, open source power tool for working with messy data and improving it

en-US.description: A free, open source power tool for working with messy data and improving it
en-US.longDescription:
OpenRefine is a powerful free, open source tool for working with messy data: cleaning it; transforming it from one format into another; and extending it with web services and external data.
Our goal is to empower everyone to meaningfully engage with data by providing an accessible open source tool and nurturing a diverse, supportive community.
en-US.name: OpenRefine

zh-CN.description: 一个免费、开源的强大工具，用于处理杂乱数据并提升其质量
zh-CN.longDescription:
OpenRefine 是一款功能强大的免费开源工具，专为处理杂乱数据而设计：既能清洗数据，又能实现不同格式间的转换，还能通过 Web 服务与外部数据进行扩展。
我们的使命是通过提供易用的开源工具和培育多元、互助的社区，让每个人都能真正实现数据赋能。
